Main article: 12-25 Years

Optimization, integration, and regularization

Emerging Adulthood (18-25): Arnett’s Framework

Five Features

Identity Exploration: Most intensive identity work in love, work, worldviews

Instability: Frequent changes in residence, relationships, work

Self-Focus: Opportunity for self-development before obligations of adulthood

Feeling In-Between: Neither adolescent nor fully adult

Age of Possibilities: Optimism, opportunity to transform life
